_comment: Single source of truth for Claude Code MCP servers registered by setup-linux.sh and setup-windows.ps1. Add new servers here; both setup scripts pick them up automatically. Args is a space-separated string of arguments passed after `--` to `claude mcp add`.
_history: 2026-05-25 SDD-007: removed `drawio` (rarely used for diagram gen, spawned subprocess even with --pure) and `socket` (mcp.socket.dev remote endpoint hung 30s+ on tool discovery). User decision: keep only hive + context7 + sequential-thinking across all environments (Claude Code, opencode, agy). 2026-06-02 HIVE-118: hive args flipped `uvx hive-vault` (per-session stdio) -> `hive client` (Phase C daemon proxy). setup-linux.sh/setup-windows.ps1 migrate an existing stale entry by REMOVING it before the registration loop so the loop re-adds `hive client` from this SSOT (no hardcoded `claude mcp add`), then install the supervised `hive serve` service gated on hive-vault >= 1.32.0. 2026-06-18 HARNESS-024 (#446): the `hive` server intentionally has NO env block — `hive client` is a stateless proxy to the `hive serve` daemon, which reads HIVE_VAULT_PATH from its OWN process env at start. The cross-machine vault path (ADR-025) is provisioned to the daemon via environment.d (Linux systemd --user) / User-scope env (Windows Scheduled Task) in setup, NOT through the MCP registration (`claude mcp add` has no --env). hive#246 hardens the daemon's own resolution.
